fields.history:
2010 — Foundation
The company was founded in a small workshop with a team of five craftsmen.
First orders were custom-made kitchen cabinets for local customers.

2013 — First Production Facility
Opened our first 500 m² production facility.
Introduced automated cutting and edge-banding equipment.

2015 — Expansion of Product Line
Added office furniture and modular storage systems to our catalog.
Partnered with three regional distributors.

2018 — International Cooperation
Started exporting to neighboring countries.
Obtained ISO 9001 quality management certification.

2020 — Digital Transformation
Launched an online catalog and order management system.
Introduced 3D visualization of custom furniture projects.

2022 — New Showroom
Opened a 300 m² showroom in the city center.
Expanded the team to 45 employees.

2024 — Sustainable Production
Switched to FSC-certified wood and water-based finishes.
Reduced production waste by 30%.

2026 — Today
Serving over 1,200 clients across the region.
Continuous investment in design, quality, and sustainability.

fields.question: What is the estimated delivery time?
fields.answer: Delivery usually takes 5–7 business days after order confirmation.

fields.question: Do you offer assembly service?
fields.answer: Yes, you can add assembly for $30 per item during checkout.

fields.question: What is your return policy?
fields.answer: You may return unused items within 14 days for a full refund.

fields.question: Can I change my delivery address after ordering?
fields.answer: Please contact support within 2 hours of placing the order.

fields.question: Do you ship internationally?
fields.answer: Currently we only ship within Belarus.

fields.question: How can I track my order?
fields.answer: A tracking link will be sent to your email once the order is dispatched.

fields.question: Are your products eco-friendly?
fields.answer: We use FSC-certified wood and water-based finishes.
